description: Add, subtract, dot and cross 2D/3D vectors. Get magnitudes, the angle between vectors and step-by-step component working.

faqs.a: The dot product v·w = x₁x₂ + y₁y₂ + z₁z₂ is a scalar measuring how much two vectors point in the same direction. It is zero exactly when the vectors are perpendicular.
The cross product v×w is a vector perpendicular to both inputs, with magnitude |v||w|sin θ. For 2D vectors the tool returns the scalar z-component.

faqs.q: How is the angle between vectors found?
faqs.a: From cos θ = (v·w) / (|v| × |w|). The tool reports θ in degrees.

howto: Enter the components of vector v and vector w.
Pick an operation: add, subtract, dot product, cross product, angle or magnitude.
Read the result with the component-by-component working.
title: Vector Calculator
